parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 measurements in nM for Renin (CHEMBL286). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL286 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM and standard_relation '='. Require canonical_smiles via INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by all output columns.
